package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	var h1, m1, h2, m2 int
	fmt.Scanf("%d:%d %d:%d", &h1, &m1, &h2, &m2)
	
	t1 := h1*60 + m1
	t2 := h2*60 + m2
	mid := (t1 + t2) / 2
	hAns := mid / 60
	mAns := mid % 60
	
	fmt.Printf("%02d:%02d\n", hAns, mAns)
}

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	var time1, time2 string
	fmt.Scan(&time1, &time2)

	parseTime := func(s string) int {
		parts := strings.Split(s, ":")
		h := 0
		m := 0
		fmt.Sscanf(parts[0], "%d", &h)
		fmt.Sscanf(parts[1], "%d", &m)
		return h*60 + m
	}

	t1 := parseTime(time1)
	t2 := parseTime(time2)

	mid := (t1 + t2) / 2
	hAns := mid / 60
	mAns := mid % 60

	fmt.Printf("%02d:%02d\n", hAns, mAns)
}
